title: Kehte Thay Roke
body:
kehte thay ro ke abid e dilgeer kya karun
zaalim bahot hai lashkare be-peer kya karun
<<DIVIDER>>
bemaar hoo ke raah ka chalna mohaal hai
us par sitam hai paaon mein zanjeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala mein aa ke ye ehsaas bhi na tha
ye din mujhe dikhayegi taqdeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
shiddat ki garm rayt pa sookhi zaban liye
tadpa hai mera asghar e baysheer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
kadiyal jawan ke seene pa naiza jo chal gaya
royi bahot hai maadar e dilgeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye to khabar thi honge bahattar ke sar qalam
be-pardagi dikha gayi taqdeer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
deen e nabi ko jis ne ujaala ata kiya
hai teeragi mein aaj wo tanveer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
bache tadap ke mar gaye pani nahin mila
wo tashnagi ki dekhi hai tasveer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab kuch luta ke dasht mein daaman ko jhaad kar
baihte thay ran mein hazrate shabbir kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
baagh e fidak ko cheen ke jab dil nahi bhara
karbobala mein loot li jageer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab phupi hai shaam ke balwe mein berida
aur har taraf hai majma e be-peer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat liye madine ki zindan e shaam mein
zer e zameen so gayi hamsheer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
nauha likha raza to qayamat guzar gayi
dil ro raha hai aur mai tehreer kya karun
kehte thay ro ke...
author: Raza Ali Khan Lakhnavi
